```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) ≥ 4 := by
  have h : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = a * (1 / a) + a * (1 / b) + b * (1 / a) + b * (1 / b) := by simp
  rw h
  simp only [one_div, mul_one, mul_comm, mul_assoc]
  apply add_le_add_right (a * (1 / b) + b * (1 / a))
  apply add_le_add_left (a * (1 / b) + b * (1 / a))
  apply add_nonneg (le_mul_div ha hb) (le_mul_div hb ha)
  apply mul_le_mul ha hb ha hb
  exact le_refl (a * (1 / b) + b * (1 / a))
```
